text:
Alex (fin): Heads up — APAC reserved GPU pool spiked overnight. Dashboard shows ~11.2k GPU-hours unallocated to teams in the last 12h (~$21k). Can someone confirm if this is a real training job or a tagging gap?
BillingBot: ALERT: Unattributed GPU usage detected in region apac-south-1. 11200 GPU-hrs, window 2026-03-22 18:00 — 2026-03-23 06:00 UTC.
Jia (ml): That's us — we kicked off a long hyperparam sweep for vision-rank yesterday and forgot to set cost_center. My bad.
Alex (fin): OK — will need a cost assignment and a path to avoid hitting team budgets. Current nightly alerts already triggered. Do you want to charge this to ML R&D (cc: ml-rd) or compensate via a one-off internal credit from Platform?
Priyanka (platform): We have limited reserved capacity for the quarter. If ML keeps consuming at that rate it pushes Dedicated SLAs. Suggest temporary credit transfer from Platform reserve to ML team, then backfill tags so billing attribution works. Need finance sign-off for internal transfer.
Sara (ops): Quick question — can we retroactively tag the jobs in the billing export? If yes, we can reassign without moving credits.
Jia (ml): We can map job IDs to the run logs. I'll run a backfill. What export column should we update?
Alex (fin): Update `cost_center` and `team` fields in the billing CSV. We'll accept backfill if it's traceable to job IDs + run metadata. We'll need an audit comment and an approval thread.
Priyanka (platform): SQL we use to find untagged runs: 
```sql
SELECT run_id, start_time, gpu_hours, user_email FROM gpu_usage WHERE region='apac-south-1' AND cost_center IS NULL AND start_time >= '2026-03-22';
```
Run that, attach the top 100 entries, then we can decide.
Jia (ml): Running now, will drop results in #eng-oncall.
BillingBot: EXPORT ready: s3://billing-exports/2026-03-23/apac-untagged-11200.csv
Alex (fin): Thanks. Proposal: two paths — 1) backfill tags and invoice ML R&D for $21k (preferred for correctness) or 2) temporary internal credit from Platform pool to avoid budget blowout this month and then reconcile next invoice. Which do we want?
Priyanka (platform): Platform can cover up to $10k this month without impacting SLAs. Anything above that needs finance approval.
Jia (ml): We prefer avoiding an ML budget overrun. Option 2 with reconciliation works for us. We'll do the backfill concurrently.
Alex (fin): I'll need the list of runs + owners and an approver from Platform to sign off on the $11.2k residual after the $10k Platform cover. Who can approve?
Priyanka (platform): I can approve up to $10k. For anything >$10k, ping @Sara and @Alex (fin) for finance approval.
Sara (ops): @Alex (fin) approve internal credit of $1.2k net after Platform covers $10k? (I can OK via finance slack approval flow.) :thumbsup:
Alex (fin): I approve the $1.2k internal credit to ML R&D contingent on the backfill CSV and run-owner mapping. Please include the following audit comment in the ledger entry: "Emergency apac-south-1 hyperparam sweep — retroactive tagging performed, run IDs attached. Internal credit applied to ML R&D, Platform covered $10k."
Jia (ml): Uploading run-owner mapping: s3://ml-logs/2026-03-22/vision-rank-backfill-owners.csv
Alex (fin): Filing a quick internal invoice so accounting can reflect the transfer. Draft invoice id: INT-2026-03123. Attaching required fields: original usage export, backfill mapping, approver screenshots.
Priyanka (platform): I'll schedule a follow-up postmortem to add an autosave tag to the job template so new runs require `cost_center` on submission.
Jia (ml): We'll add a pre-submit hook in our training repo too.
Sara (ops): I'll update alert thresholds to add a secondary guard: if untagged GPU-hours > 1k in 4h, page oncall instead of just notify channel.
Alex (fin): Thanks everyone. Action checklist: 1) Jia — finish backfill and drop CSV (done). 2) Priyanka — approve $10k platform cover (done). 3) Alex — approve remaining $1.2k (done). 4) Sara — raise alert/pager change (in progress). 5) Create INT invoice and attach artifacts (Alex). Marking this thread resolved once invoice posted.
Priyanka (platform): :white_check_mark: I'll also open a ticket to add quota caps per-team for burst windows.
BillingBot: NOTE: internal-transfer recorded pending invoice INT-2026-03123.
Alex (fin): Posting invoice now. INT-2026-03123 posted to accounting queue. Leaving audit comment. Closing thread after accounting confirms payment routing. :wave:
